content.comment_body: Hello, Can anyone assist me? - I have a program with two screens shown on the operator panel. One screen is used to set parameters such as time, while the other is for monitoring the remaining time. Is there a way to switch between these screens? For example, by changing the character set or with input signals within the program? Thank you for any help.
Hi, You can use M27 to toggle between the two selected languages on the operator panel. I hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to find a programmatic method for switching between different screens on a [company_name] operator device, such as transitioning from a parameter-setting screen to a time-monitoring screen. The current guidance references language switching as a workaround via M27, but does not directly address changing between custom screens, indicating that clearer documentation or support may be needed for this function.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate having a simple way to programmatically toggle between multiple custom screens on the operator device, ideally through configurable inputs or device settings.
